propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event exists in .tickets-tracker when a write process dies before completing its first event emission, creating an orphan directory.

The plan-relation reducer fails when walking a snapshot's relation graph and encounters an event-less directory, surfacing INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets whose graph paths traverse the orphan.
The orphan directory never appears in git status and cannot be gitignored because git does not track empty directories, making it invisible to branch history but persistent in local clones.

The plan-relation reducer must tolerate and skip event-less ticket directories with a warning rather than failing the snapshot, to repair existing broken clones and unblock plan reviews of unrelated tickets.

The writer (event_append._prepare_event) creates the ticket directory via os.makedirs before the first event write; leaving this behavior unchanged and fixing tolerance reader-side avoids unsafe concurrent cleanup and repairs existing failures.
